summary: A dropdown menu of agents where brand-colored icons opt out of the item's text color, including a scheme-aware monochrome mark.
use: Pickers that list third-party products or agents with their real logos, such as a new-tab or integration menu.
spec: `<DropdownMenuLabel>Agents</DropdownMenuLabel>` followed by 4 items: Shell, Claude Code, Codex, Coming soon
Shell uses `{#snippet icon()}<Bot />{/snippet}`; Claude Code and Codex set `brandIcon` so the inline `svg` keeps its own colors
Codex wraps `<SchemeAsset>` with `{#snippet light()}` and `{#snippet dark()}` svg variants
Each item sets `last` through `onclick`, shown as `Opened: {last}` with `aria-live="polite"`
